test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

He __benevolently__ offered to drop me all the way home after the office party got over in the wee hours of the morning.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"benevolently"** means in a manner that shows kindness and goodwill. (दयालुता से)

 
 
• **Example: **She **benevolently **donated a large sum to the orphanage.
 
 
 
• **"Unkindly"** refers to a manner lacking kindness or sympathy. (निर्दयता से)
 
 
• **Example: **He spoke** unkindly **to the waiter, showing no regard for his feelings.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'benevolently' **is **'unkindly'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tenderly **(स्नेहपूर्वक): In a gentle, loving, or kind way.

 
 
• **Example:** He** tenderly** held the baby in his arms.
 
 
 
• **Humanely **(मानवीय रूप से): In a way that shows compassion or benevolence.
 
 
• **Example: **The animal was treated** humanely **during the rescue operation.
 
 
 
• **Selflessly** (निःस्वार्थ रूप से): In a way that shows concern more for the needs and wishes of others than for one's own.
 
 
• **Example:** She worked **selflessly** to help those in need.
 
 

41:Tba4,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
